SRC-364:R001.text: D-01 Verbatim-Source-Capture: Ingress authority requires verbatim capture of operator instructions without model paraphrasing

SRC-364:R002.text: D-02 Premature-Handback-Prevention: Narrative handback prohibited while executable phases remain eligible on current ticket

SRC-364:R003.text: D-03 Requirement-Traceability-Matrix: Generic test counts must not substitute for mapped clause-by-clause requirement verification

SRC-364:R004.text: D-04 Acceptance-Contract-Enforcement: Lifecycle completion requires non-empty verified acceptance criteria matching source claims

SRC-364:R005.text: D-05 Canonical-Commit-and-Release-Delivery: Canonical fix commit and staged package delivery for host repository

SRC-364:R006.text: D-06 Blocker-Truth-Classification: Distinct classification of technically verifiable, external, and unresolved blocker categories
